fusions.name: Overhand Hurl
fusions.desc: Reaches up to 5 tiles to seize an enemy and hurls it 3.5 tiles back, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Borrowed Cudgel
fusions.desc: Hurls a rock gripped in one arm at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Returned Grip
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
